presentation.speaker: kai
presentation.title: A rival cuts prices
lines: {rival} is cutting prices in {market}. Big groups are buying smaller brands. Choose a position, then make the corresponding price and operating changes.

choices.label: Choose niche
choices.detail: Raise prices; rely on good reviews or pay for a brand campaign. Lower volume, lower price sensitivity.
choices.outcome: The direction is recorded. Apply its real price and operating response from the company terminal or phone.

choices.label: Choose scale
choices.detail: Lower prices and buy more inventory. Volume rises, but margin thins and stock consumes cash.
choices.outcome: The direction is recorded. Apply its real price and operating response from the company terminal or phone.

choices.label: Review a market that can no longer operate
choices.detail: Continue the story without claiming a price response, sales or survival. Use this if the company closed or the retail route is unavailable.
choices.outcome: The unavailable route is recorded honestly. Maya can help you choose the next chapter.
